banner.title: CPC Training.
banner.subtitle:
Professional CPC training built around drivers
and businesses.
banner.text: PBL Training delivers straightforward, professional CPC training backed by real transport industry experience, with flexible options for individuals and businesses.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose PBL Training
whyChoose.text: Whether you’re booking for yourself, a small team or a larger group, PBL provides practical CPC training with a straightforward, flexible approach.

modules.title: Our CPC Training Modules
modules.text: Choose from a range of professional CPC training modules for drivers and transport businesses, with flexible options for individuals and groups. Each course includes seven hours of training, excluding breaks.

items.title: Licence, Weights & Dimensions
points: Legislation (including Drivers Hours, Rules and Regulations and the Working Time Directive)

items.title: Vehicle Checks & Defects
points: Legislation (including Drivers Hours, Rules and Regulations and the Working Time Directive)

items.title: Company & Public Image
points: Economic Environment for Carriage of Goods (LGV)

items.title: Drivers Hours
points: Understanding drivers’ hours and working time regulations
Driving limits, breaks and daily/weekly rest requirements
Tachograph use, record keeping and avoiding common infringements

items.title: Economical Driving
points: Economic Environment for Carriage of Goods (LGV)
Economic Environment for Carriage of Passengers (PCV)

items.title: Tachograph
points: Legislation (including Drivers Hours, Rules and Regulations and the Working Time Directive)

items.title: Safe Loading
points: Principles of safe and secure vehicle loading
Correct use of load restraints and securing equipment
Understanding load distribution, stability and driver responsibilities

testimonials.title: Happy Customers
testimonials.text: Our training customers value PBL for practical, professional CPC courses, knowledgeable instructors and a straightforward approach from enquiry through to completion.

location.title:
CPC Training in
Birmingham & Nationwide
location.text: Conveniently based in Birmingham, PBL Training provides professional CPC training for individual drivers, transport operators and businesses across the local area. With practical, industry-led courses and flexible options for groups, our team makes it straightforward to arrange the training you need.

location.calloutTitle: Not in Birmingham? We can come to you.
location.calloutText: We can come to you and deliver professional CPC training directly at your premises, making it convenient and straightforward for your drivers and team. Alternatively, we also offer selected CPC courses online, giving you greater flexibility to complete your training wherever you’re based.

form.title: Enquire About CPC Training
form.text: Tell us which course you’re interested in and a little about your training requirements. Our team will get back to you to discuss the best option for you or your drivers.
